recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookie
recipes.desc: One big, chewy cookie studded with hand-chopped chocolate chips. Warm, gooey and the reason the Toddler Titan stopped stomping in the tutorial.
steps: Dough by hand: ING_BUTTER, ING_SUGAR, ING_EGG, ING_FLOUR, ING_CHOCOLATE.
Bake the ING_FLOUR dough ball (with ING_BUTTER, ING_SUGAR, ING_EGG, ING_CHOCOLATE) on MED.
cx: I count six chips. A cookie needs SEVEN chips minimum.
It's not warm. A cookie must be warm. It's the law.
recipes.look: A large golden cookie with big chocolate chunks and a slightly gooey centre.
recipes.anim: Cookie breaks in two with a chocolate string during ANM_043 (prop swap + beam).
recipes.vfx: Warm steam curl; crumbs on the plate.
recipes.mut: Classic Peace Offering dessert (C11.5). `MUT_178` Golden Chef Hands chefs get a 'golden-brown' bark; Kitchen Pro on the bake.

recipes.name: Vanilla Ice Cream
recipes.desc: Two swirled scoops of vanilla in a waffle cone. The plainest thing on the menu, and somehow always the first to sell out of smiles.
steps: Seat the scoops in the ING_WAFFLE_CONE and stand it in the holder.
cx: The second scoop is leaning. It's going to fall. I'm going to cry.
Vanilla? I said VANILLA. This is... yes, fine, this is vanilla.
recipes.look: Waffle cone with two pale-cream swirl scoops and a tiny curl on top.
recipes.anim: Customer licks (ANM_043 lick variant); scoop wobbles.
recipes.vfx: Cold sparkle; a drip particle after 30 s.
recipes.mut: Sweet Tooth speeds the scoop for `sweet`-tagged chefs (`MUT_080` Gummy Bear Eyes); Peace Offering classic.

recipes.name: Donut Ring
recipes.desc: A fried dough ring dunked in chocolate frosting and sprinkled into a rainbow. The hole is free.
steps: Punch the hole in ING_DOUGH (2 taps).
Fry the ING_DOUGH ring; shake once.
ING_DOUGH ring, ING_SUGAR dust, ING_FROSTING chocolate glaze, ING_SPRINKLES.
cx: The hole is too small. I paid for a full hole.
Sprinkle distribution: 70/30. Unbalanced.
recipes.look: Golden ring with a glossy chocolate glaze and rainbow sprinkles, perfect round hole.
recipes.anim: Customer peers through the hole (ANM_041 variant) before eating.
recipes.mut: Hot Hands on the fry; `MUT_051` Clown Nose customers wear it as a nose (cosmetic bark).

recipes.name: Strawberry Sundae
recipes.desc: Two scoops crowned with chopped strawberries, whipped cream and a cherry. Lovebird couples order one with two spoons and then argue over the cherry.
steps: Two scoops of ING_ICE_CREAM_BASE into the sundae glass.
cx: The cherry is off-centre. Love is about balance.
Too much cream. I can't find the strawberries. Send help.
recipes.look: Tall glass with pink-and-cream scoops, red strawberry chunks, a whipped-cream swirl and a glossy cherry.
recipes.anim: Cherry boings on its stem when served (prop spring).
recipes.mut: Sweet Tooth on the scoop; plant parts widen the strawberry chop zone.

recipes.name: Brownie Brick
recipes.desc: A dense, fudgy brownie cut into a perfect brick and drizzled with caramel. Builders have used it as a load-bearing dessert.
steps: Batter: ING_BUTTER, ING_SUGAR, ING_EGG, ING_CHOCOLATE, ING_FLOUR.
Bake the ING_FLOUR batter (ING_BUTTER, ING_SUGAR, ING_EGG, ING_CHOCOLATE) on MED.
cx: This brick isn't square. It's a rhombus. I'm furious.
Too fudgy. I can't build with this.
recipes.look: A dark rectangular brownie block with a crackly top and caramel zig-zag.
recipes.anim: Customer knocks on it like a door (ANM_043 lead-in) — it goes 'thunk'.
recipes.vfx: Small crumb dust puff on the knock.
recipes.mut: `MUT_060` Beaver Teeth and `MUT_218` Beaver Tail (repair) customers try to build a dam with it (bark).

recipes.name: Birthday Cake Slice
recipes.desc: A tall vanilla sponge wedge with fluffy frosting, rainbow sprinkles and a candle that relights itself every time someone sings. Birthday Beasts demand it daily.
steps: Batter: ING_BUTTER, ING_SUGAR, ING_EGG, ING_VANILLA, ING_MILK, ING_FLOUR.
Bake the ING_FLOUR sponge (ING_BUTTER, ING_SUGAR, ING_EGG, ING_VANILLA, ING_MILK) on LOW.
cx: Nobody sang. Is it even my birthday if nobody sings?
The candle relit four times. I'm out of wishes.
recipes.look: Tall white-frosted wedge with rainbow sprinkles, visible sponge layers and a striped candle with a cartoon flame.
recipes.anim: Candle flickers and relights after the customer blows it out (ANM_043 blow variant); nearby customers clap.
recipes.vfx: Cartoon candle flame (prop, not on any character) and confetti puff.
recipes.mut: Party customers (`PER_016`) trigger a table-wide cheer; Kitchen Pro on the low bake; `MUT_272` Sparkle Aura chefs add free extra sparkle.

recipes.name: Pie in the Face (Edible)
recipes.desc: A banana cream pie built for slapstick: a cloud of whipped cream so tall the customer may choose to faceplant into it. It is 100 % edible and 100 % voluntary.
steps: Cook custard: ING_MILK with ING_EGG, stirring.
ING_PIE_CRUST, ING_MILK custard with ING_EGG, ING_BANANA, ING_WHIPPED_CREAM cloud.
Plate with a napkin. Just in case.
recipes.sat: Faceplant option: customers who love it may playfully dunk their face (cosmetic, no anger, no cleanliness penalty)
cx: The cream wasn't tall enough to faceplant. I'm devastated.
I didn't want to faceplant but now I feel left out.
recipes.look: A golden crust brimming with custard and banana under a towering white cream cloud.
recipes.anim: Optional faceplant: customer leans in, comes up with a cream beard and a big grin (ANM_043 variant).
recipes.vfx: Cream splat 'POOF' (white puff, comic stars of joy).
recipes.mut: `MUT_051` Clown Nose customers always choose the faceplant (bark); Kitchen Pro on the crust bake and Spark Blend on the cream cloud.

recipes.name: Rainbow Slime Jelly
recipes.desc: Seven bands of fruit slime jelly set into a jiggling tower and topped with cream. It burbles happily when the table is bumped.
steps: Layer by layer: ING_SLIME_JELLY, ING_RAINBOW_SYRUP, ING_SUGAR (seven colour bands).
Set the ING_SLIME_JELLY tower in the freezer (8 s).
Unmould onto the plate with one confident shake.
cx: It's not jiggling. Jelly that doesn't jiggle is just a rock.
The orange band is fatter than the green band. Favouritism.
recipes.look: A translucent seven-colour jelly tower that jiggles and burbles, with a cream cap.
recipes.anim: Tower jiggles on any nearby bump (prop jiggle bone) and burbles.
recipes.vfx: Bubbles rising inside the jelly; rainbow glints.
recipes.mut: Cold Snap on the set; `MUT_134` Slime Body customers wave at it like a relative (bark).

recipes.name: Exploding Cupcake
recipes.desc: A cupcake whose frosting is laced with Kaboom Crystals: the first bite pops with crackles and a burst of confetti. Kid-safe, ear-safe, and very, very loud.
steps: Bake the ING_FLOUR cupcake (ING_BUTTER, ING_SUGAR, ING_EGG) on MED.
Kaboom frosting: ING_FROSTING first, ING_KABOOM_CRYSTALS last.
ING_FLOUR cupcake, ING_FROSTING kaboom swirl, ING_SPRINKLES.
Plate pointing away from anyone nervous.
cx: It fizzled. I wanted a KA-BOOM, not a ka-pfft.
Too loud! My antennae are ringing!
recipes.look: Tall swirl-frosted cupcake with crackling crystals glinting in the frosting and a striped paper wrapper.
recipes.anim: On the first ANM_043 bite the frosting pops up and the customer's hair/feathers puff out (cartoon).
recipes.vfx: Confetti burst and comic 'POP!' text (Reduced Effects: text only, no screen shake).
recipes.mut: `MUT_068` Megaphone Mouth customers out-pop the cupcake (bark); Kitchen Pro on the bake.

recipes.name: Bug Brittle
recipes.desc: Glassy caramel brittle packed with candy Bug Crunch and candied nuts, snapped into shards. Every beetle is chocolate and caramel. Every crunch is legendary.
steps: Cook ING_SUGAR, ING_BUTTER and ING_CARAMEL to hard-crack.
Fold fast: ING_CARAMEL candy, ING_BUG_CRUNCH, ING_CANDIED_NUTS.
Plate the shards in a jagged fan.
cx: Only candy bugs? I wanted to meet the real... no. No, I didn't.
The brittle bent. Brittle must SNAP.
recipes.look: Amber glass-like shards studded with shiny candy beetles and nuts.
recipes.anim: Shards snap with a satisfying crack during ANM_043.
recipes.mut: Customers wearing `MUT_027` Fly Head or `MUT_126` Bee Body react with delight (bark); Cold Snap speeds the set.

recipes.name: Frozen Lava Cake
recipes.desc: A chocolate cake with a molten Lava Sauce core, baked hot then flash-frozen on the outside. Cold shell, hot heart, confused tongue.
steps: Batter: ING_BUTTER, ING_SUGAR, ING_EGG, ING_CHOCOLATE, ING_FLOUR.
Ramekin: ING_FLOUR batter, ING_LAVA_SAUCE core, ING_CHOCOLATE top.
Bake the ING_FLOUR cake with its ING_LAVA_SAUCE core (ING_BUTTER, ING_SUGAR, ING_EGG, ING_CHOCOLATE) on HIGH, briefly.
Flash-freeze the outside shell (5 s) — the core stays molten.
One scoop of ING_ICE_CREAM_BASE on the side.
Plate; the first spoon releases the lava.
cx: The lava didn't flow. Dormant volcano. One star.
Cold outside, cold inside. This is just a Frozen Cake.
recipes.look: Frosty dark-chocolate dome dusted with frost sparkles; when cut, glowing orange sauce flows out beside a vanilla scoop.
recipes.anim: Lava ooze flows out when the spoon cuts in (texture scroll + mesh).
recipes.vfx: Frost sparkles meeting orange glow; a steam-and-snowflake puff.
recipes.mut: `ABL_067` Freeze Touch replaces the freezer step; fire parts speed the bake: perfect for `MUT_262` Yeti Frost Fur + `MUT_254` Fireproof Skin chefs.

recipes.name: Cloud Cotton Candy
recipes.desc: Spun from a real tiny Cloud Fluff and rainbow sugar. It drizzles a few sugar raindrops on the table and occasionally rumbles with distant, adorable thunder.
steps: Spin ING_CLOUD_FLUFF with the tinted ING_SUGAR until it puffs out of the lid (stop before lid-pop).
Twirl the ING_CLOUD_FLUFF candy onto a paper cone.
Stand it in the cone holder; it floats slightly.
cx: It rained on my shoes. Sugar rain, sure, but still.
It's a small cloud. I wanted a cumulonimbus.
recipes.look: A huge pastel rainbow puff on a paper cone with a faint drizzle of sparkly raindrops underneath.
recipes.anim: Cloud bobs gently and rumbles (prop tween + scale pulse).
recipes.vfx: Sparkly sugar-rain particles and a tiny cartoon lightning glyph (Reduced Effects: no lightning).
recipes.mut: `MUT_197` Cloud Leg and `MUT_274` Storm Cloud Hat chefs make it rumble in harmony (bark); Spark Blend speeds the spin.

recipes.name: Screaming Sorbet
recipes.desc: Scream Berries blended with lemon and frozen into a sorbet that lets out a tiny delighted shriek with every scoop. Brain freeze not included (the scream warns you).
steps: Blend ING_SCREAM_BERRY, ING_SUGAR, ING_LEMON and ING_ICE smooth.
Scoop two shrieking balls of ING_SCREAM_BERRY sorbet.
cx: It screamed at the wrong pitch. I'm a trained singer.
Not cold enough to scream properly.
recipes.look: Two violet sorbet balls with tiny open-mouth dimples, frosted bowl, lemon twist.
recipes.anim: Each scoop 'screams' (mouth dimple widens) when the spoon touches it.
recipes.mut: Cold Snap / `ABL_067` Freeze Touch skips the freezer; `MUT_068` Megaphone Mouth customers duet with it (bark).

recipes.name: Galaxy Cheesecake
recipes.desc: Creamy baked cheesecake under a swirling Galaxy Glaze nebula with blueberry planets and sprinkle stars. Food critics have described it as 'astronomically smug'.
steps: Fill ING_PIE_CRUST with the ING_CREAM_CHEESE mix.
Bake ING_PIE_CRUST with the ING_CREAM_CHEESE, ING_SUGAR and ING_EGG filling on LOW.
Chill the cheesecake (8 s) so the glaze sets.
ING_PIE_CRUST, ING_CREAM_CHEESE, ING_GALAXY_GLAZE swirl, ING_BLUEBERRY planets, ING_SPRINKLES stars.
Cut a clean wedge (2 taps) without smudging the galaxy.
cx: Your galaxy has a typo. That star is in the wrong constellation.
Too beautiful to eat. I'm eating it anyway. I'm upset about it.
recipes.look: Pale cream wedge topped with a deep purple-blue swirling glaze, glossy blueberry planets and glittering stars.
recipes.anim: Glaze slowly rotates (texture scroll); a tiny comet streaks across the top every 5 s.
recipes.vfx: Twinkle particles and soft purple glow.
recipes.mut: Glow Guide on the glaze; `MUT_138` Cosmic Nebula Body customers get a 'mirror selfie' bark.

recipes.name: The Dessert That Bites Back
recipes.desc: Chocolate cake, cream and berries guarded by sleepy Chomp-Chomp Gummy Jaws that playfully nibble the spoon (never the customer) before being eaten in revenge.
steps: Bake the ING_FLOUR chocolate cake (ING_SUGAR, ING_EGG, ING_CHOCOLATE) on MED.
Keep ING_CHOMP_GUMMY jaws sleepy in the freezer (8 s).
ING_FLOUR cake, ING_WHIPPED_CREAM, ING_STRAWBERRY, ING_CHOMP_GUMMY jaws, ING_CHERRY eyes.
Plate quickly — they wake up in 20 s.
cx: It didn't bite back. I wanted a rivalry.
It nibbled my spoon and I've never felt so seen.
recipes.look: A chocolate cake dome with a pink gummy jaw on top, cherry eyes, strawberry 'tongue' and a cream ruff.
recipes.anim: Gummy jaw chomps the air and nibbles the spoon prop twice (prop bones) before the customer eats it with a triumphant ANM_043.
recipes.vfx: Comic 'chomp chomp' text and cartoon motion lines (no teeth marks on anyone).
recipes.mut: Cold Snap keeps the jaws asleep longer (the 20 s wake timer doubles while frozen-tagged); `MUT_062` Shark Jaws customers have a friendly staring contest with it (bark).
